title: SEC1: TLS-safe mode constraint undocumented in public header
description: The public header crypto2dev_port.h documents wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid() only as 'register device, enable TLS-safe mode (hash -> software), and assign devId'. It does not explain WHY hash must fall back to software: wc_Sha256Copy fails when hardware holds streaming state (no session-snapshot ioctl), which corrupts the TLS transcript hash during key derivation. This constraint is documented in the COPY handler comment inside crypto2dev_port.c (line 1507-1521) and in the g_tls_safe_mode declaration comment (line 339-343), but neither location is visible to a maintainer reading only the header. A maintainer adding a new hash algorithm or considering removal of TLS-safe mode has no callsite-visible warning of the consequence. The header comment for wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid should state the invariant and its consequence.
